record.details: Compare the current checkout failure rate with the previous hour. Check whether failures cluster around a release, a payment provider, or a region. Confirm the signal across at least two dashboard samples. For the escalation, capture the affected endpoint, error rate, start time, region, and any recent deploy. An isolated successful retry can be documented on the ticket without paging the on-call engineer.

record.summary: Escalate to platform-oncall when HTTP 503 persists for at least five consecutive minutes in two or more regions.
record.details: Check each affected region and confirm the failures are ongoing. Include the status code, duration, and affected regions in the proposal.

record.summary: Escalate to platform-oncall if the oldest undelivered event is at least 15 minutes old and the backlog is still growing.
record.details: Compare queue depth and oldest event age across samples. If the queue has drained, document the recovery and monitor delivery.
